questions.q: Which object carries the routing or transit number used to route money to a specific location?
questions.explain: The Bank Branch carries routing-level detail such as a routing/transit number, address, and supported payment methods.

questions.q: What is linked to a Bank Account to determine where reconciled transactions post in the General Ledger?
questions.explain: Each Bank Account is linked to a cash account in the General Ledger, which is where reconciled transactions ultimately post.

questions.q: Can a single Bank record be shared by branches and accounts belonging to unrelated companies?
options: Yes, the Bank object itself carries no company-specific data
No, each Bank record is company-specific
Only if both companies share the same legal entity
Only for banks outside the United States
questions.explain: The Bank record is just the institution; it carries no company-specific data, so it can be shared across unrelated implementations.

questions.q: In a full implementation with many bank accounts across multiple legal entities, what is the typical approach to loading bank/branch/account data?
options: Entering every record one at a time in the UI
Copying data directly from the General Ledger
Importing a BAI2 bank statement file
A bulk spreadsheet upload using the ADFdi-enabled template
questions.explain: Implementations with many accounts typically build the data in a spreadsheet template and upload it in bulk rather than entering each record manually.

questions.q: What is the required create order for the bank account hierarchy?
questions.explain: A Bank must exist before its Branches, and a Branch must exist before its Accounts — the hierarchy is always created top-down.
